what: a join of a triangular prism and a thin slab with rounded corners (r 4.9) that share their bottom plane, the prism's edge in that plane lying in the slab's end face
method: prism: triangle (y,z) = (-63,0), (-3,0), (-63,60) extruded 1.2 along x (x 4.4..5.6): 1.2*0.5*60*60 = 2160. slab: rounded rectangle 10x64 (y -67..-3), r 4.9, 0.4 thick: 0.4*(640-(4-pi)*4.9^2). The prism's sloped face is z = -3-y, so at height z it reaches y = -3-z; overlap = Int over z in 0..0.4 of the area of {x in 4.4..5.6, -63 <= y <= -3-z} inside the slab (the corner arcs, centres (4.9,-7.9) and (5.1,-7.9), narrow it for y > -7.9), integrated numerically with Simpson = 28.704. Union = prism + slab - overlap
